main_text.p: libus a Sexta Synodo innotuissent, quae post Photium apud Orientales per multos annos indemnata fuere. Ergo vel Photius impius est, & auitae suae fidei proditor, qui ab Hæreticis in thronum restitui procurauit, & cum ipsis associatus uti fratres, & Patres eos agnoscit, & laudat, & eorum se precibus ad Deum committit: vel hae postremae Synodi Actiones nullo modo sub Pho-tio habitae sunt: & sic erunt figmenta, ac portenta posteriorum Schismaticorum impudenti solertia adinuenta.

Neq; enim de Photio viro sanctissimo, & Catholicae fidei propugnatore aliud sentiendum est, qui Synodo Septimae illiusque decretis addictissimus, nunquam passus esset illius dogmata vel minimum violari, cum in ea a Tarasio Actione prima definitum legatur Τὸ κακὸν ἤδη κακόν ἐστι, ἢ μάλιστα ἐν Ἐκκλησιαστικοῖς πράγμασι [?]. τὸ γὰρ ἐν δόγματι εἴτε ἐν μικρῷ [?], εἴτε ἐν μεγάλῳ ἁμαρτάνειν, τοῦτο ἔστιν· ὡς ἀμφοτέρων γὰρ ὁ νόμος τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀπαγορεύει [?]. Quod malum est, iam utiq; malum est, & maxime in negotijs Ecclesiasticis. In dogmatum quippe causa, siue in parua, siue in magna peccare, id ipsum est: ex utrisque enim lex Dei improbatur. Quæ & Photium adnotasse, obseruasseque ex ipsius Epistola Encyclica cognoscimus: Καὶ γὰρ ἔχειν ὄντως κοινὰ πάντων· ἃ πάντας φυλάττειν ἐπάναγ-

page.notes: Greek passage is only partly legible at this resolution; words marked [?] are doubtful. The Greek is copied in Greek letters as printed. The long s has been written as plain s throughout. The printed "vt" has been changed to "ut" as instructed; the "vtiq;", "vtrisque" and "Quæ" forms are otherwise as printed. The page ends mid-word at "ἐπάναγ-", with the printed hyphen kept.
